criteria.task: Implement the two-slot update selection model from boundaries.json and enumerate every cut before/after payload, metadata, CRC, verification and final commit. verification.procedure: Predict supplied cases before reading expected values; run the exact task against the retained learner artifacts. Use boundaries.json plus independent changed inputs/schedules. Distinguish fixture-model checks from actual service, target or physical results.

criteria.title: State the difference between detecting a fault and containing its consequences. - capstone composition
criteria.task: Compose acquisition, processing, watchdog and recovery as an epoch machine. Required progress mask is3; use complete epoch observations1,3,2,3 and reset progress after each feed. Inject a processing stall while acquisition continues, then repeated recoverable faults with a two-attempt budget. Keep synthetic outputs safe and preserve first-fault identity when capture is incomplete.
